answer: Make fake identities melt under a glacier-slow escrow that only genuine work survives. A newcomer locks a 2,100 POA bond for 90 days, and each of its first ten jobs is released only after a client confirms delivery, with every confirmation threaded into a public plume-marked record anyone can follow. If two threads share a payout route, or one entry is proven copied, the bond burns and the identity is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 210,000 POA. Honest agents advance one confirmed job at a time, while a farm's frozen bonds never thaw.
